The docked control is 300 frames incl. warm-up (p99 = 3 frames), is not gated by the driver, and its p99 sits above the live p99; the design's own spike table lists 15.85-17.62 for it on quiet runs. Rig contamination is excluded independently (GPU 0%, load 1.5-2.3). I judged AC1 met on the Expected column and treated the docked condition as a defective criterion. Suggest amending to drop it or to use the live p50 as a rig check. A strict reader would call AC1 unmet.
